metas.name: Spirited Away
metas.description: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

metas.name: They Will Kill You
metas.description: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a NYC high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realizes the community is shrouded in mystery.

metas.name: No Other Choice
metas.description: After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.

metas.name: Batman Begins
metas.description: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.

metas.name: Mortal Kombat II
metas.description: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: Lucky follows the spiritual journey of a 90-year-old atheist and the quirky characters that inhabit his off the map desert town.

metas.name: Braveheart
metas.description: Scottish warrior William Wallace leads his countrymen in a rebellion to free his homeland from the tyranny of King Edward I of England.

metas.name: Don't Look Up
metas.description: Two low-level astronomers must go on a giant media tour to warn humankind of an approaching comet that will destroy planet Earth.

metas.name: Mulholland Drive
metas.description: After a car wreck on Mulholland Drive renders a woman amnesiac, she and a Hollywood-hopeful search for clues and answers across Los Angeles in a twisting venture beyond dreams and reality.

metas.name: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: A middle-aged husband's life changes dramatically when his wife asks him for a divorce. He seeks to rediscover his manhood with help from new acquaintance Jacob, who teaches him to pick up women at bars.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A thief and his team of associates plan a sophisticated heist to rob three Las Vegas casinos at the same time.

metas.name: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
metas.description: Shang-Chi, the master of weaponry-based Kung Fu, is forced to confront his past after being drawn into the Ten Rings organization.

metas.name: Rush
metas.description: James Hunt and Niki Lauda, two extremely skilled Formula One racers, have an intense rivalry with each other. However, it is their enmity that pushes them to their limits.

metas.name: Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: The Revenant
metas.description: A frontiersman on a fur trading expedition in the 1820s fights for survival after being mauled by a bear and left for dead by members of his own hunting team.

metas.name: Mystic River
metas.description: The tragic murder of a 19-year-old girl reunites three childhood friends still living in Boston--the victim's gangster father, a detective, and the disturbed man they both suspect of killing her.

metas.name: The Furious
metas.description: A father fights fiercely against ruthless kidnappers to save his abducted daughter.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: Catch Me If You Can
metas.description: A runaway teenager lives an exciting life by forging checks and impersonating several professions, but his fraudulent activities soon attract the attention of the FBI.

metas.name: Companion
metas.description: A weekend getaway with friends at a remote cabin turns into chaos after it's revealed that one of the guests is not what they seem.

metas.name: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
metas.description: Doctor Strange teams up with a mysterious teenage girl who can travel across multiverses, to battle other-universe versions of himself which threaten to wipe out the multiverse. They seek help from the Scarlet Witch, Wong and others.

metas.name: American Beauty
metas.description: A sexually frustrated suburban father has a mid-life crisis after becoming infatuated with his daughter's best friend.

metas.name: The Long Walk
metas.description: A group of teenage boys compete in an annual contest known as "The Long Walk," in which they must maintain a certain walking speed or get shot.

metas.name: The Covenant
metas.description: An Afghan interpreter saves the life of a US Army Sergeant, who will do everything in his power to repay the favor and secure American visas for him and his family.

metas.name: A Clockwork Orange
metas.description: Alex DeLarge and his droogs barbarize a decaying near-future.

metas.name: A League of Their Own
metas.description: During World War II, sisters Dottie and Kit join the first female professional baseball league and struggle to help it succeed amid their own growing rivalry.

metas.name: Scream
metas.description: In the small town of Woodsboro, California, a masked killer known as Ghostface begins murdering high school students, and a group of friends must use their knowledge of horror movies to unmask the killer.

metas.name: La La Land
metas.description: When Sebastian, a pianist, and Mia, an actress, follow their passion and achieve success in their respective fields, they find themselves torn between their love for each other and their careers.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

metas.name: Thor: Ragnarok
metas.description: Imprisoned on the planet Sakaar, Thor must race against time to return to Asgard and stop Ragnarök, the destruction of his world, at the hands of the powerful and ruthless villain Hela.

metas.name: Speak No Evil
metas.description: A family is invited to spend a whole weekend in a lonely home in the countryside, but as the weekend progresses, they realize that a dark side lies within the family who invited them.

metas.name: Skyfall
metas.description: James Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt her. When MI6 comes under attack, 007 must track down and destroy the threat, no matter how personal the cost.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: Through a series of freak occurrences, a group of actors shooting a big-budget war movie are forced to become the soldiers they are portraying.

metas.name: Joker
metas.description: Arthur Fleck, a party clown and a failed stand-up comedian, leads an impoverished life with his ailing mother. However, when society shuns him and brands him as a freak, he decides to embrace the life of chaos in Gotham City.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description: In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.

metas.name: The Bourne Identity
metas.description: A man is picked up by a fishing boat, bullet-riddled and suffering from amnesia, before racing to elude assassins and attempting to regain his memory.

metas.name: Edge of Tomorrow
metas.description: A man fighting in a war against aliens must relive the same day every time he dies until he can find a way to stop their power source with the help of an elite soldier.

metas.name: Full Metal Jacket
metas.description: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.

metas.name: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
metas.description: Grace MacCaullay battles old wounds with her estranged sister Faith MacCaullay while rival occult dynasties hunt them through a deadly contest that promises power, survival, and betrayal before dawn.

metas.name: The Brutalist
metas.description: A visionary architect flees post-war Europe in 1947 for a brighter future in the United States and finds his life forever changed by a wealthy client.

metas.name: The Goonies
metas.description: A group of young misfits called The Goonies discover an ancient map and set out on an adventure to find a legendary pirate's long-lost treasure.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: The owner of an aging high-class hotel regales a writer with tales of serving as a lobby boy under an exceptional concierge in the hotel's glory years.

metas.name: The Lives of Others
metas.description: In 1984 East Berlin, an agent of the secret police conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover finds himself becoming increasingly absorbed by their lives.

metas.name: 2001: A Space Odyssey
metas.description: When a mysterious artifact is uncovered on the Moon, a spacecraft manned by two scientists and one supercomputer is dispatched to Jupiter to find its origins.

metas.name: The Nightmare Before Christmas
metas.description: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, discovers Christmas Town, but his attempts to bring Christmas to his home causes confusion.

metas.name: Richard Jewell
metas.description: Security guard Richard Jewell is an instant hero after foiling a bomb attack at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics, but his life becomes a nightmare when the FBI leaks to the media that he is a suspect in the case.

metas.name: Longlegs
metas.description: In pursuit of a serial killer, an FBI agent uncovers a series of occult clues that she must solve to end his terrifying killing spree.

metas.name: Air Force One
metas.description: The US President must save himself and his family when Air Force One is hijacked by communist radicals with them on board.

metas.name: Gladiator II
metas.description: After his home is conquered by the tyrannical emperors who now lead Rome, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum and must look to his past to find strength to return the glory of Rome to its people.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
metas.description: With their warning about Lord Voldemort's return scoffed at, Harry and Dumbledore are targeted by the Wizard authorities as an authoritarian bureaucrat slowly seizes power at Hogwarts.

metas.name: 28 Years Later
metas.description: A group of survivors of the rage virus live on a small island. When one of the group leaves the island on a mission into the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other su...

metas.name: Ratatouille
metas.description: A rat who can cook makes an unusual alliance with a young kitchen worker at a famous Paris restaurant.

metas.name: Fury
metas.description: A grizzled tank commander makes tough decisions as he and his crew fight their way across Germany in April, 1945.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

metas.name: Goldfinger
metas.description: While investigating a gold magnate's smuggling, James Bond uncovers a plot to contaminate the Fort Knox gold reserve.

metas.name: The Conjuring
metas.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse.

metas.name: Insidious
metas.description: A family looks to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further.

metas.name: Drop
metas.description: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a terrifying turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening messages on her phone during their upscale dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming date is behind the harassment.

metas.name: It Follows
metas.description: A young woman is followed by an unknown supernatural force after a sexual encounter.

metas.name: 500 Days of Summer
metas.description: After being dumped by the girl he believes to be his soulmate, hopeless romantic Tom Hansen reflects on their relationship to try and figure out where things went wrong and how he can win her back.

metas.name: The Shadow's Edge
metas.description: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

metas.name: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
metas.description: A female assassin seeks revenge on her former lover and squad members, all of whom left her for dead.

metas.name: Captain America: The First Avenger
metas.description: Steve Rogers, a rejected military soldier, transforms into Captain America after taking a dose of a "Super-Soldier serum". But being Captain America comes at a price as he attempts to take down a warmonger and a terrorist organiza...

metas.name: Gremlins
metas.description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

metas.name: Reservoir Dogs
metas.description: When a simple jewelry heist goes horribly wrong, the surviving criminals begin to suspect that one of them is a police informant.

metas.name: Enemy
metas.description: A mild-mannered college professor investigates the life of an actor who looks exactly like him.

metas.name: Romeo + Juliet
metas.description: Shakespeare's famous play is updated to the hip modern suburb of Verona still retaining its original dialogue.

metas.name: Hook
metas.description: When Captain James Hook kidnaps his children, an adult Peter Pan must return to Neverland and reclaim his youthful spirit in order to challenge his old enemy.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: An overachieving London police sergeant is transferred to a village where the easygoing officers object to his fervor for regulations, all while a string of grisly murders strikes the town.

metas.name: The Martian
metas.description: An astronaut stranded on Mars must rely on his ingenuity to survive and arrange a potential rescue.

metas.name: The Big Short
metas.description: Prior to the 2008 financial crisis, a group of investors bet against the US mortgage market and are stunned by the corruption they uncover through their research.

metas.name: Casino
metas.description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description: A young boy and his little sister struggle to survive in Japan during World War II.

metas.name: Ready Player One
metas.description: When the creator of a virtual reality called the OASIS dies, he makes a posthumous challenge to all OASIS users to find his Easter Egg, which will give the finder his fortune and control of his world.

metas.name: Logan
metas.description: In a future where mutants are nearly extinct, an elderly and weary Logan leads a quiet life. But when Laura, a mutant child pursued by scientists, comes to him for help, he must get her to safety.

metas.name: 12 Monkeys
metas.description: In a future world devastated by disease, a convict is sent back in time to gather information about the man-made virus that wiped out most of the human population on the planet.

metas.name: American Psycho
metas.description: A wealthy New York City investment banking executive, Patrick Bateman, hides his alternate psychopathic ego from his co-workers and friends as he delves deeper into his violent, hedonistic fantasies.

metas.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
metas.description: Journalist Mikael Blomkvist is aided by eccentric hacker Lisbeth Salander in his search for a woman who has been missing for 40 years.

metas.name: White Chicks
metas.description: Two disgraced FBI agents go way undercover in an effort to protect hotel heiresses the Wilson sisters from a kidnapping plot.

metas.name: Bring Her Back
metas.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

metas.name: Blade Runner
metas.description: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

metas.name: Ran
metas.description: In Medieval Japan, an elderly warlord retires, handing over his empire to his three sons. However, he vastly underestimates how the new-found power will corrupt them and cause them to turn on each other...and him.

metas.name: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End
metas.description: Manel is sheltering from a rabies-like disease which sweeps the planet, until he is forced to leave and meet unlikely but essential traveling companions.

metas.name: Predator: Badlands
metas.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: A wisecracking mercenary gets experimented on and becomes immortal yet hideously scarred, and sets out to track down the man who ruined his looks.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
metas.description: Still reeling from the loss of Gamora, Peter Quill rallies his team to defend the universe and one of their own - a mission that could mean the end of the Guardians if not successful.

metas.name: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
metas.description: After waking from a four-year coma, a former assassin wreaks vengeance on the team of assassins who betrayed her.

metas.name: Hoppers
metas.description: A 19-year-old animal lover uses technology that places her consciousness into a robotic beaver to uncover mysteries within the animal world beyond her imagination.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

metas.name: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
metas.description: Hunt and the IMF pursue a dangerous AI called the Entity that's infiltrated global intelligence. With governments and a figure from his past in pursuit, Hunt races to stop it from forever changing the world.

metas.name: Sentimental Value
metas.description: An intimate exploration of family, memories, and the reconciliatory power of art.

metas.name: Sing 2
metas.description: Buster Moon and his friends must persuade reclusive rock star Clay Calloway to join them for the opening of a new show.

metas.name: Primal Fear
metas.description: A high-profile murder intrigues a publicity hungry lawyer.

metas.name: Once Upon a Time in America
metas.description: A former New York gangster returns after decades in exile, confronting the friendships, dreams, and regrets that shaped his rise from street kid to Prohibition-era mobster.

metas.name: Pearl Harbor
metas.description: Two lifelong friends and a beautiful nurse are caught up in the horror of an infamous Sunday morning in 1941.

metas.name: Amadeus
metas.description: In 18th-century Vienna, court composer Antonio Salieri becomes awed and consumed by envy when the gifted, irreverent Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart bursts onto the imperial music scene.

metas.name: Rebel Ridge
metas.description: A former Marine grapples his way through a web of small-town corruption when an attempt to post bail for his cousin escalates into a violent standoff with the local police chief.

metas.name: The Man from Earth
metas.description: A professor's impromptu retirement party becomes a mysterious interrogation when he reveals to his colleagues that he has a longer and stranger past than they can imagine.

metas.name: Tombstone
metas.description: A successful lawman's plans to retire anonymously in Tombstone, Arizona, are disrupted by the kind of outlaws he was famous for eliminating.
